fields.statement: Verifier, attempt 2, at 50de518c (fix for review finding f1 on top of bed13ffa). go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-picks|describe-golden)$' -count=1 -v: both PASS. daemon-picks covers RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES=1 GiB -> daemon --once starts nothing, opens no rex tab, daemon status --json shows reason disk-low with '1.0 GiB free, under the minimum of 10.0 GiB'; 20 GiB -> one run started; --min-free 0 at 1 GiB -> run started; --min-free lots rejected. Read the code: daemonPoll1 skips daemon.Resumable when low, so resumes are held too. describe-golden includes --min-free. Fix diff: daemonDiskLow now reads RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES through ctxGetenv and only when RHIZA_TEST_NOW is set, matching testRenderStale and Decision disk-guard-10-gib. Built the binary and ran daemon --once in a scratch repo with RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES=5: without RHIZA_TEST_NOW, no disk_low in daemon.state.json and no blocked status. With RHIZA_TEST_NOW set, it emits the blocked 'disk space is low' status. make fmt-check, vet and go test ./... pass; one make test run tripped the read-timing benchmark under load and passed on three reruns. make self-check fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered actor files from the review run's chore commits, which this leaf's commits do not touch.
